method: Unit polygons and surface-management polygons are projected to EPSG:5070 (NAD83 / Conus Albers). The share is the intersection area divided by the unit area. Counted land is BLM and U.S. Forest Service, plus the state-open layers named below. A second, higher share adds uncertain land. If the two shares fall in different bands, the unit is omitted. Bands are 70 percent or more (mostly public), 40 up to 70 percent (mixed), and under 40 percent (mostly private). Gap of 0.2 percentage points or less is treated as the same share.

landlocked.reason: No official layer used here marks public parcels that have no legal public-road access. A road-buffer estimate would not be a reliable access determination, so landlocked parcels are not flagged.

policy.rule: State Land Board land is not counted unless the parcel is in CPW's public-access property layer (STL, SWA, or Hunting Access).
State trust land is open to hunting, fishing, and recreation except cultivated cropland, and only where legally accessible.
Only IDL features marked Access = Yes are counted as open state land.
Undifferentiated state trust land is not counted.
No state-trust hunting layer was joined. State land stays in the uncertain share.

co.name: CPW Managed Properties (public access only)
co.description: This data was created by the CPW GIS Unit. Property boundaries are created by dissolving CDOWParcels by the property name, and property type and appending State Park boundaries designated as having public access. All parcel data correspond to legal transactions made by the CPW Real Estate Unit. The boundaries of the CDOW Parcels were digitized using metes and bounds, BLM's GCDB dataset, the PLSS dataset (where the GCDB dataset was unavailable) and using existing digital data on the boundaries.

co.counted: BLM, USFS, and CPW public-access properties of type SWA, STL, and Hunting Access (Non-STL)
co.not_counted: NPS, DOD, BIA/tribal, local, private, undifferentiated SMA state land (Colorado State Land Board land is not open unless it is in the CPW public-access layer)
co.uncertain: FWS and BOR. A unit is skipped when adding that land would change the band.
co.sheep_goat: Only CPW sheep and goat units with HUNTING = YES

wy.uncertain: FWS, BOR, and SMA state land. Wyoming trust land is open to hunting except cultivated cropland and only where legally accessible (OSLI Chapter 13). This build does not have the cropland or access polygons, so state land can only confirm a band, not raise it.

id.counted: BLM, USFS, and IDL Public Access features with Access = Yes
id.uncertain: FWS, BOR, and SMA state land that may sit outside the IDL yes layer. A band is kept only when that extra land would not change it.
id.skipped_subunits: Hunt areas such as 36A-1 are not in the GMU polygon layer

nv.uncertain: FWS, BOR, and SMA state land. Nevada has little state land; a band is kept only when that land would not change it.
nv.units: NDOW hunt units with a three-digit display name and is_active true. Named closures (parks, ranges) are not units.

ut.counted: BLM and USFS inside the DWR hunt boundary
ut.not_counted: SITLA / SMA state land is not counted. Utah trust land is not public hunting land unless a separate access program covers it, and this build does not have that enrollment layer. NPS, DOD, BIA, local, and private are not counted.
ut.uncertain: FWS and BOR. A boundary is skipped when adding that land would change the band.
ut.wma: UDWR wildlife management areas were not unioned as their own layer. They are not subtracted, and they are not added beyond whatever BLM or Forest Service land they do not overlap.

keys_are_traceable: Every browser band key is a key in exact.json with status computed.
